names.ja: アーキテクチャプラン

intro.zh: 浅蓝与深蓝灰面板左右交替，编号导航与金黄色结构标记；适合技术方案、架构说明和咨询类规划汇报。
intro.en: Light-blue and blue-grey panels alternating left and right, numbered navigation and gold structural markers; for technical proposals, architecture walkthroughs and planning readouts.
intro.ja: ライトブルーとブルーグレーのパネルが左右交互に並び、番号ナビとゴールドのマーカー。技術提案や設計説明向け。

routing.avoid: Dense tables or wide charts: the side panel leaves a narrow content column.

pageMapping.differences: Source keeps the title on a white column with a star badge, gold underline, dark button and two figures, and puts a darker rounded image block on a light-blue band at the right; native draws a flat empty light-blue panel on the left that the title straddles, inside a hairline frame, with no badge, button, figures or image block.

Source has the image panel on the left with a rounded image block, a badge title with gold underline, three rounded pale cards with a gold left bar, a figure row and a button; native has an empty flat panel on the opposite side, three square outlined cards and no figures, badge or button.

Source is two titled paragraphs each with a gold left bar plus a large figure, beside a right image panel; native is a plain bullet list beside an empty flat panel on the left, with no gold bars or figure.

Source has a left image panel with a rounded image block, three rounded pale cards with a gold left bar and a figure with caption; native has an empty flat panel on the right, three square outlined cards and no figure.

Source has three rounded pale cards with bullet lists and a gold left bar, a figure with caption and a right image panel with a rounded image block; native has an empty flat panel on the left, square outlined cards with one body line and no figure.

Source closing turns the whole page dark navy with white title, gold underline, gold button and a figure; native reuses the light cover layout with a light-blue panel and hairline frame, no dark canvas, button or figure.
